subject: Physics
question:
If the monochromatic source in Young's double slit 
experiment is replaced by white light, then

options.a:
there will be a central bright white fringe surrounded by a 
few coloured fringes.
options.b: all bright fringes will be of equal width.
options.d:
there will be a central dark fringe surrounded by a few 
coloured fringes.
(Polarization Phenomenon, Law of Malus and Brewster’s Law)

explanation:
When we use white light in place of monochromatic 
light, the central fringe appears white, while the other 
fringes display different colours. This is because the central 
fringe for all colours is formed at central point, so it appears 
white after mixing up. As fringes of other colours fall at 
different positions, we see fringes of all colours on either 
side of the central bright fringe.

explanation:
The I – V characteristics of solar cell is drawn in the 
fourth quadrant of the coordinate axes. This is because a 
solar cell does not draw current but supplies the same to the

terminals. Thus, a very small drift current flows through 
the diode due to minority charge carriers of both n-side and 
p-side.
